content: The median costs of various insulin products in the United States, calculated as Average Wholesale Price (AWP) and National Average Drug Acquisition Cost (NADAC) per 1,000 units of specified dosage forms, are as follows: 1. Aspart (Rapid-Acting Insulin): This insulin is available in U-100 vials, cartridges, and prefilled pens. The median AWP for these products ranges from $174 to $430. The median NADAC for these products ranges from $139 to $344. 2. Aspart (Faster-Acting Product): This formulation is also available in U-100 vials, cartridges, and prefilled pens. The median AWP for this faster-acting version ranges from $347 to $447. The median NADAC for this product ranges from $277 to $357. 3. Glulisine (Rapid-Acting Insulin): This insulin is available in U-100 vials. The median AWP for Glulisine is $431. The median NADAC for Glulisine is $327. 4. Lispro (Rapid-Acting Insulin): Lispro is available in U-100 and U-200 vials, as well as prefilled pens. The median AWP for these products ranges from $330 to $424. The median NADAC for these products ranges from $324 to $338. 5. Lispro-aabc (Rapid-Acting Insulin): This insulin is available in U-100 and U-200 vials and prefilled pens. The median AWP for Lispro-aabc ranges from $424 to $438. The median NADAC for Lispro-aabc ranges from $339 to $351. 6. Lispro Follow-On Product (Biosimilar Insulin): This product is available in U-100 vials and prefilled pens. The median AWP for the follow-on product is $181. The median NADAC for the follow-on product is $151.
